title: Project Beacon – Confidential Information Memorandum: Lighthouse Logistics Group
summary: William Blair-prepared CIM for Lighthouse Logistics Group ("Project Beacon"), a technology-enabled regional LTL and final-mile freight provider headquartered in Charlotte, NC. The company operates 14 terminals across the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic, a fleet of 680 vehicles, and a proprietary route-optimization platform (BeaconOS). LTM Sep 2023 revenue of $218M and Adj. EBITDA of $33.7M (15.5% margin). The e-commerce final-mile segment grew 41% YoY and represents 28% of revenue, with a target of 40%+ by 2026. BeaconOS is also white-labeled to 3PLs generating $2.1M ARR. The process kicked off in Aug 2023 with a Q1 2024 targeted signing/close. Implied EV of ~$310M based on 9.2x LTM EBITDA. Platform acquisition opportunity in a highly fragmented Southeast LTL market.

key_quotes.quote: BeaconOS route optimization reduces cost-per-stop by 14% vs. manual dispatch; 97.4% OTD rate — top decile for regional LTL
Final-mile e-commerce segment grew 41% YoY; now 28% of revenue, targeted at 40%+ by 2026
Southeast LTL market estimated at $8.4B; top-5 regional players hold <30% share; Lighthouse is #3 by terminals
7-year average customer tenure; top-20 customers represent 52% of revenue with no single customer >8%
BeaconOS white-labeled to 2 regional 3PLs — SaaS revenue stream of $2.1M ARR at 80%+ gross margin

growth_drivers: Final-mile e-commerce segment growing 41% YoY; targeted at 40%+ of revenue by 2026
BeaconOS proprietary route optimization reduces cost-per-stop by 14%; top-decile 97.4% OTD rate
BeaconOS SaaS licensing to 3PLs generating $2.1M ARR at 80%+ gross margins
Healthcare logistics vertical growing at 3-year CAGR of 24%; provides counter-cyclical stability
Highly fragmented Southeast LTL market ($8.4B TAM) with active bolt-on acquisition pipeline
risks: Top-20 customers represent 52% of revenue — moderate customer concentration
~22% of volume sourced through freight brokers, exposing margins to broker rate fluctuations
Asset base includes 680 vehicles with ongoing fleet refresh capital requirements
Integration risk from planned tuck-in terminal acquisitions
Cyclicality inherent in LTL freight volumes tied to industrial and retail end markets

title: PROJECT BEACON — Executive Summary Teaser | Lighthouse Logistics Group
